interface.longDescription: Software architecture design and auditing with versioned project requirements/ADRs, three adjustable answer depths, explicit change-impact analysis, repository/PR evidence mapping, developer handoff artifacts, a local interactive workbench, capacity modeling, automated structural checks and evaluation fixtures. Conditional GitHub connector support requires authorization. Local files and workbench are not automatically cloud-synced or hosted as an MCP App.
defaultPrompt: Design a scalable architecture for a ride-sharing app and explain key trade-offs.
Help me choose a database and tenant-isolation model for my B2B SaaS product.
Review my proposed architecture and write a prioritized improvement plan.
